intro: Niger is rich in uranium but one of the poorest countries in the world.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Uranium mining near Arlit has supplied nuclear power stations abroad. An oil pipeline to Benin opened in 2024. Most people farm millet and herd livestock.

chapters.title: Onions
text: The purple 'violet de Galmi' onion is sold across West Africa.

keyTerms.meaning: A metal used as nuclear fuel.

cardGroups.title: Made in Niger
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Niger makes and sells to the world.
